name: BC NB Product Error Ruleset
description: The global error ruleset file used for all Business Central NB Products

rules.justification: Flowfields should not be editable on the table level as directed by Microsoft
InDataset and ForUpdate Property has been deprecated by Microsoft
Method declaration should not end in semicolon
All objects must have explicit permission declaration on accessing tabledata
String Literals cannot be used in Event Subscribers as they limit implementation and reference searches.
Do not use line breaks in ToolTip; Business Central does not render formatting and the backslash appears literally
ToolTip should not exceed 200 characters so users can scan them quickly
Empty captions should be locked so they are not extracted into translation files
Writing to a FlowField requires a comment explaining why, since FlowField values are not persisted
Do not use Object IDs as object references; use object names for readability and compile-time safety
Use parenthesis for function calls so method invocations are visually distinct from property access
Function calls should have parenthesis even if they do not have any parameters
